## About

ComponentOne Themes for WinForms makes it easy to theme your WinForms controls with many built-in themes and an easy to use theme designer to create your own themes or modify the existing ones.

Key Features:

* Provide a consistent customized look to applications that use ComponentOne WinForms controls.
* The look of an application can be changed with a single click at design or run time.
* The look of your applications can be designed or modified by visual designers without coding.
* Use one of the pre-built themes, or create new theme from scratch, or by modifying a pre-built theme.
* Themes can be deployed independently of applications, and used by different applications.
* Within a theme, a common repository of properties can be referenced throughout the theme to enable creation of consistent and easily modifiable themes.

Learn more at [www.grapecity.com/controls/winforms/themes](https://www.grapecity.com/controls/winforms/themes).
